# proxmox_cluster_firewall_alias (Resource)

Manages a cluster firewall IP or network alias through `/cluster/firewall/aliases`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_cluster_firewall_alias" "monitoring" {
  name    = "monitoring"
  cidr    = "10.20.0.10"
  comment = "Monitoring server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR network.
- `name` (String) Stable alias name. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Alias comment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Alias name.
